name: pathview
description: Turns each path a reply names into a link, and lists the paths after the reply with a folding preview of each and buttons that open them in your editor

editor.title: Editor
editor.description: Where open takes a text file when the editor command below is empty. auto uses VS Code in VS Code's terminal, $EDITOR in a kitty window in kitty, and the system's opener elsewhere. vscode opens a tab in VS Code from any terminal on your own machine. system always uses the system's opener.

editorCommand.title: Editor command
editorCommand.description: Opens a text file, such as zed {file}:{line}, and comes before the Editor setting. {file} is the file's full path and {line} the line a reply named, or 1.

terminalCommand.title: Terminal command
terminalCommand.description: Starts a terminal in a folder, such as wezterm start --cwd {dir}. Empty uses kitty where the session runs in it, and draws no terminal button elsewhere.

imageCommand.title: Image viewer command
imageCommand.description: Opens a picture, such as qimgv {file}. Empty uses the system's opener.

browserCommand.title: Browser command
browserCommand.description: Opens an HTML page or a PDF, such as firefox {file}. Empty uses the system's opener.
